title: Amazing Bouncy Mexican Pork Carnitas
description: A delicious and tender Mexican dish featuring pork, capers, and dashi extract, with a unique bouncy texture, inspired by the Jalisco style, and halal friendly.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat the lard or oil over medium heat.
Add the pork chunks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the dashi extract, capers, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven, where it will cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 1/2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Using two forks, shred the pork into bite-sized pieces and return it to the pot.
Continue to cook the pork for an additional 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the pot from the heat and let the carnitas cool to room temperature.
Serve the carnitas warm, garnished with additional capers and a sprinkle of oregano if desired.
